<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="490" height="200" viewBox="0 0 490 200" font-family="'Courier New', Courier, monospace" xmlns:c2pa="http://c2pa.org/manifest">
<defs><filter id="glow" x="-20%" y="-30%" width="140%" height="160%">
<feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3" result="b"/>
<feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
</filter></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="488" height="198" rx="12" fill="#0D1220" stroke="#00F0FF" stroke-opacity=".35"/>
<text x="472" y="100" text-anchor="end" font-size="96" font-weight="700" fill="#00F0FF" opacity=".07">04</text>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="488" height="198" rx="12" fill="none" stroke="#00F0FF" stroke-width="2.5" pathLength="1000" stroke-dasharray="90 910" filter="url(#glow)">
<animate attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" from="0" to="-1000" dur="7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect>
<rect x="0" y="30" width="4" height="30" fill="#00F0FF"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;.3;1" dur="2.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect>
<text x="28" y="56" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="#00F0FF" filter="url(#glow)">ANÁLISIS DOCUMENTAL</text>
<text x="28" y="80" font-size="12.5" fill="#FCEE0A" letter-spacing="1">MACHINE LEARNING APLICADO</text>
<text x="28" y="108" font-size="13" fill="#C9D6EA">Selección y análisis inteligente de</text><text x="28" y="128" font-size="13" fill="#C9D6EA">documentación en un contexto</text><text x="28" y="148" font-size="13" fill="#C9D6EA">municipal.</text>
<rect x="28" y="158" width="125.6" height="24" rx="5" fill="#00F0FF" fill-opacity=".1" stroke="#00F0FF" stroke-opacity=".55"/><text x="38" y="174" font-size="11" fill="#00F0FF" textLength="105.6" lengthAdjust="spacing">MACHINE LEARNING</text><rect x="161.6" y="158" width="86.0" height="24" rx="5" fill="#00F0FF" fill-opacity=".1" stroke="#00F0FF" stroke-opacity=".55"/><text x="171.6" y="174" font-size="11" fill="#00F0FF" textLength="66.0" lengthAdjust="spacing">DOCUMENTOS</text><rect x="255.6" y="158" width="53.0" height="24" rx="5" fill="#00F0FF" fill-opacity=".1" stroke="#00F0FF" stroke-opacity=".55"/><text x="265.6" y="174" font-size="11" fill="#00F0FF" textLength="33.0" lengthAdjust="spacing">DATOS</text>
<circle cx="414" cy="26" r="4" fill="#00F0FF"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;.2;1" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
<text x="426" y="30" font-size="11" fill="#6B7A99" letter-spacing="1">ACTIVO</text>
<metadata><c2pa:manifest></c2pa:manifest></metadata></svg>
